title: Releasing a Customer Hold on Factory Production Orders — Desk Note and Release Tool
content:
**Rule.** For Factory Production Orders, at release the current ship date is reset to the requoted ship date, and a delay notice with cause customer hold records that new date. The ship date set at a hold's release is worked out only after the order carries a delay notice with cause late acknowledgment whenever its acknowledgment was signed after the return window.

## Applicable situation

A hold ends when the customer asks for release or, at the latest, when it reaches the class maximum hold length. Release returns the order to the production queue in the entered status. The hold start date and the committed ship date stay as they were.

## The waiting condition, restated

Where the order's acknowledgment was signed after the return window, the release date's ship date is worked out only once a delay notice with cause late acknowledgment stands on the order's records.

## Business effect

| Item | After release |
|---|---|
| Order status | entered |
| Current ship date | the requoted ship date |
| Milestone records | a delay notice with cause customer hold, dated the release date, recording the requoted ship date |

## The release tool: `release_customer_hold_268345ec`

**Capability.** The tool releases a customer hold on a factory production order so it re-enters the production queue. One call moves the order from on hold back to entered, sets its current projected ship date to the new date given, and records the matching delay notice dated today with the cause customer hold and that new date. The hold start date and the date committed on the acknowledgment stay as they were. Afterwards the order shows the entered status and the new current ship date, and the notice is listed among its milestone records.

**Invocation.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `release_customer_hold_268345ec` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `factory_order_id` | the reference number of the factory production order being released, as returned by the factory order lookup for the customer | identifier |
| `days_to_new_ship_date` | the new projected ship date, written as a number of calendar days from today's date to that date | whole integer; 0 means today |

**Return.** A dictionary receipt with `status` (`released` on success), `factory_order_id` (the released order), `order_status` (the order's status after the call, `entered`), `order_milestone_id` (the reference number of the hold delay notice), `release_date` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `new_ship_date` (the order's new current ship date, YYYY-MM-DD).
